configurations.name: streamlit-demo
runtimeArgs: exec env PYTHONFAULTHANDLER=1 uv run streamlit run examples/app.py --server.headless true

configurations.name: bench-10k
runtimeArgs: exec env PYTHONFAULTHANDLER=1 ST_LONBOARD_PERF=1 BENCH_N=10000 uv run streamlit run benchmarks/bench_app.py --server.headless true > /tmp/bench_10k.log 2>&1
